feed.title: SOTA · AJ6X
feed.subtitle: Summits On The Air: activation reports and trail notes.

entry.title: Hawkins Peak W6/SC-213
entry.summary: A 4 AM start by last week's clock, stairs cut into the rock on the High Peaks, a volunteer with a Yagi, and a very hot way down Condor Gulch.

entry.title: South Chalone Peak W6/SC-153
entry.summary: Three ways into South Chalone's activation zone: a summit decorated with trash, a snake that wouldn't move, and 15m open to Japan from deep in the brush.

entry.title: North Chalone Peak W6/SC-149
entry.summary: Three trips through the Bear Gulch caves to the fire lookout on North Chalone: 20m CW, and an Outhouse On The Air.

entry.title: Black Mountain W6/NC-386
entry.summary: The first ever activation of Black Mountain, on MALT's Day on the Ranch: 40m for the regulars, 15m for DX, and a QRT mid-pileup.

entry.title: Hicks Mountain W6/NC-362
entry.summary: The first ever activation of a private Marin summit, on a MALT ranch hike: six contacts on 40m CW, with seven minutes to spare.
